title: Air Photo Interpretation
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is considered as a black body with a temperature of 5,900 K."
The sun is considered as a black body with a temperature of 5,900 K.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used surfaces should be as clean as possible and the interpreter should either wear cotton gloves or be sure not to touch the emulsion surface as skin oils can cause image deterioration."

Anytime transparencies are used surfaces should be as clean as possible and the interpreter should either wear cotton gloves or be sure not to touch the emulsion surface as skin oils can cause image deterioration.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the magnitude of oscillating electric field."
The amplitude is the magnitude of oscillating electric field.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the process of transmission of the electro-magnetic radiation through the atmosphere, and the influence of the atmosphere."
Radiative transfer is defined as the process of transmission of the electro-magnetic radiation through the atmosphere, and the influence of the atmosphere.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the reflectance using the incident light source from the sun."
Albedo is defined as the reflectance using the incident light source from the sun.
fib: ______ is one of the most helpful interpretation clues in identifying man made installations.
Association is one of the most helpful interpretation clues in identifying man made installations.
______ are the elements of image interpretation.
The stimuli are the elements of image interpretation.
______ is a more systematic method of analysis most often used by interpreters.
Logical search is a more systematic method of analysis most often used by interpreters.
______ may be defined as each distinguishable variation on an image produced by a multitude of combinations of hue, value and chroma.
Color may be defined as each distinguishable variation on an image produced by a multitude of combinations of hue, value and chroma.
______ can be defined as the study of something without making actual contact with the object of study.
Remote sensing can be defined as the study of something without making actual contact with the object of study.
